evidence.detail: Earlier reviews recover rs/s/m/a as NotesConfig, rs/s/m/b as NotesPanel and rs/s/m/f as NotesPlugin; rs/s/m/e is the sole remaining Notes-package helper between the reviewed redo action and plugin.

NotesPanel constructs exactly one rs/s/m/e instance and attaches it directly to the Notes JTextArea with addFocusListener, fixing the class as a focus listener for the Notes document rather than a generic UI listener.
rs/s/m/e implements java.awt.event.FocusListener. focusGained is a no-op; focusLost performs the class's only substantive behavior.
On focusLost the listener reads the complete Notes JTextArea Document with getText(0, getLength()) and writes that exact String through the reviewed NotesConfig notesData setter.

The only exceptional path catches BadLocationException and logs the exact Notes-specific prefix 'Notes Document Bad Location: ', reinforcing that the listener's whole responsibility is persisting Notes document text when focus is lost.

proposals.note: NotesSaveFocusListener is fixed by direct NotesPanel JTextArea attachment, FocusListener shape, and exclusive focusLost persistence of the complete document through NotesConfig. Confidence is 0.999.
